title: Allow multi-row queue priority selection
summary: Queue rows now support a separate multi-row priority selection set while preserving the existing active selected row for detail panels, Launch handoffs, and open-command context.
reason: The Queue priority toolbar could only apply High, Normal, Low, or Hold to the single active Queue row. Operators need to select several explicit rows and apply one priority change through the existing backend-owned Queue priority route.
behavior_before: Clicking a Queue row replaced the single selected row. The High, Normal, Low, and Hold toolbar buttons posted one path from that row, while bulk behavior was limited to the all-Movie and all-TV shortcuts.
behavior_after: Clicking a Queue row still updates the active selected-row detail. Ctrl/Cmd-click and Space toggle rows into the priority selection set, Shift-click adds a visible range, the Queue legend reports total and visible priority selection counts, and the priority toolbar sends selected rows through the existing bulk /api/queue/priority items payload.
